messages.author: a56f5d963739d221
messages.subject: Re: Bootstrap Themes
parts:
Hi Nick,
Bootswatch is definitely the place to go, as Ian pointed out.  It is important, though, to make sure you access the 2.3.2 version. This is the version used by Shiny although it is the unsupported version.  You can most easily (I think) access the bootstrap theme like this:
shinyUI(navbarPage(theme="http://maxcdn.bootstrapcdn.com/bootswatch/2.3.2/cerulean/bootstrap.min.css" ...
where 'cerulean' happens to be the name of the theme I chose.


Alternatively, you can download the theme to host it locally or on your server.  I haven't done this yet so I can't really give you guidance on it.  This would be the way to go if you wanted to tweak the theme.
